hypothesis: The Fortet-linearized scipy.optimize.milp (HiGHS) solver returns the exact global optimum, agreeing with exhaustive enumeration on every tiny instance (n<=18) in the benchmark ladder.
benchmark_problem: Synthetic OptionSelectionInstance ladder, all families (experiments.quantum1b.generators.FAMILIES), n in [4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18]
stopping_rule: run to completion, bounded by n<=18

pass_fail_interpretation.PASS: 100% of (family, n, seed) cells agree within tolerance 1e-6
pass_fail_interpretation.FAIL: any disagreement -- a P0 defect in the linearization, blocks downstream Track A/B comparisons until fixed

prohibited_conclusion: none -- this is a correctness gate, not a scientific claim
